subject: polity
title: 12 Schedules of the Constitution
description: All 12 schedules with tricks to remember them

content.overview: The Constitution originally had 8 schedules. Now it has 12 schedules added through amendments.
keyPoints: 2nd Schedule: Emoluments of President, VP, PM, Governors, Judges, CAG, etc.
4th Schedule: Allocation of Rajya Sabha seats to states
5th Schedule: Administration of Scheduled Areas and Scheduled Tribes
6th Schedule: Administration of Tribal Areas in Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, Mizoram
7th Schedule: Union List, State List, Concurrent List
9th Schedule: Land Reforms laws (added by 1st Amendment 1951)

mnemonics.trick: 22 Languages: Assamese, Bengali, Bodo, Dogri, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Kashmiri, Konkani, Maithili, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Nepali, Odia, Punjabi, Sanskrit, Santali, Sindhi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu
mnemonics.explanation: 8th Schedule has 22 official languages. Originally 14, later added Sindhi (21st), Konkani/Manipuri/Nepali (71st), Bodo/Dogri/Maithili/Santali (92nd)

quiz.question: Which schedule deals with Anti-Defection law?
quiz.explanation: 10th Schedule deals with Anti-Defection law (52nd Amendment 1985)

quiz.question: How many languages are in the 8th Schedule?
7th Schedule contains:
quiz.explanation: 7th Schedule contains Union List, State List, and Concurrent List
